latin: Ens dicit immediate decem conceptus ita inter se unitos ut non unius sint, sed ad unum.
translation: Being directly expresses ten concepts so bound together that they do not belong to a single thing, but are all ordered toward one.
translation_note: In the series on metaphysical unity (Farmer's note, farmer1998:11749). Sense checked against farmer1998:11726.
